progression_rule: Main lifts (deadlift, dumbbell bench, step-up): when every set is done with clean form at RPE 8 or easier, add weight next time: deadlift +5 kg, step-up +2.5 kg, dumbbell bench +2.5 kg per dumbbell, row +2.5 kg. If you miss reps, repeat the weight. Miss twice in a row, drop 10% and build back. Chin-ups: add 1 rep per set up to 4x6, then switch to a lighter band and go back to 4x3. Dips: add 1 rep per set up to 3x10 before any added load. Sessions 16-18 are a deload: 2 rounds only, same weights, finish early. Busy-week minimum: 2 rounds of the deadlift and the dumbbell bench only (about 20 min). Back after 7+ days off (illness, travel, moving): use 80% of your last weights for 2 sessions, then carry on. Strength is weekdays 5:30-6:30; cardio is separate (weekend or a spare morning) and gets logged as cardio, not here. Sharp pain, numbness or a niggle that isn't settling: stop that lift and see a GP or physio.

days.name: Day A - Deadlift, then DB Bench, Chin, Face Pull
days.warmup: 5 min easy bike. 10 glute bridges, 10 bodyweight box squats, 10 band pull-aparts, 30 s dead hang. Then deadlift ramp-up sets (bar, ~50%, ~75%) and 1 light set of dumbbell bench.

exercises.name: Barbell deadlift
exercises.notes: Own station on the floor, away from the rack. Do all 4 sets here first, then move to the B circuit. Brace before each pull, bar close to the shins. Last diary best 120x5, so start well under.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bench press
exercises.notes: 25 kg in each hand to start (about the same effort as the 62.5 kg barbell). Shoulder blades pinned, elbows about 45 degrees from your sides. Bench set up away from the rack so the chin-up bar stays clear.

exercises.name: Band-assisted chin-up
exercises.notes: Band-assisted, as you've been doing them. Use the band that gives 4 clean reps. Full hang at the bottom, chin over the bar.

exercises.name: Cable rope face pull
exercises.notes: Pull to the eyebrows, thumbs back. Posture work for the desk days. Paramount stack is in pounds.

days.name: Day B - Step-up, Row, Dip
days.warmup: 5 min easy bike. 10 glute bridges each leg, 10 walking lunges, 10 band pull-aparts, 5 slow bodyweight dips at shallow depth. Ramp-up: 1 set of 6 step-ups each leg with the bar only.

exercises.name: Barbell step-up
exercises.notes: 8 each leg. Knee-height box. Diary best 60x8. Replaces back squat for now.

exercises.name: One-arm dumbbell row
exercises.notes: 8 each arm, hand on bench. Diary best about 41.5x5.

exercises.name: Parallel-bar dip (bike seat and treadmill arm)
exercises.notes: Bodyweight only. Go down until upper arms are parallel, no deeper. Stop if the shoulder complains.

exercises.name: Cable Pallof press
exercises.notes: 10 each side. Ribs down, don't let the cable turn you. Paramount stack is in pounds.
